bio: Operated by well-known chef Beata Śniechowska, this modern bistro is one of those spots where you just know you’re going to have a good time. Closely set tables add to the intimacy and buzz of the atmosphere, while bright and friendly service quickly puts you at ease. The cooking provides great value and generous flavours; just take the ‘Tribute to Polish Homes’, which offers a finely judged take on classic homemade meatloaf, with a subtle spiced kick. A strong selection of Polish wines is on hand to complete the experience....
